0022600113.text: The Nets (0-1, 10th in the East, 4th in the Atlantic and 2 games back) host the Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back). Brooklyn is without Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder), while Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), and Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with a hamstring strain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Nets lost the series 1-2, including a 123-94 loss in Brooklyn on April 9, 2026.
